exportWizard.repoHint: Only repositories integrated into DevDigest can run reviews

exportWizard.previewError: Couldn't generate the preview. Try again.
exportWizard.allTriggersOffReason: Select at least one trigger to continue.
exportWizard.blockMergeDesc: To block merges: set Fail CI on (CI tab) so the run exits non-zero, then add a required status check in the repo's GitHub branch protection. No GitHub App needed.
exportWizard.installCardTitle: Open a PR with these files
exportWizard.installCardBody: DevDigest opens a PR in {repo} titled “Add DevDigest CI review” with the {count} generated files.
exportWizard.zipCardBody: Download the generated files as a zip and commit them to the repo yourself.
exportWizard.secretNote: Add {key} to the repo's Actions secrets before the workflow runs.
exportWizard.prOpenedBody: DevDigest opened a pull request in {repo} with the generated files.
exportWizard.filesDownloadedBody: The zip has been downloaded. Commit the files to {repo} to finish setup.
exportWizard.ingestTokenBody: Add this as the {key} secret in {repo}'s GitHub Actions settings so DevDigest can record run results. Copy it now — it won't be shown again.
exportWizard.checklistApiKey: Add an OPENROUTER_API_KEY secret (Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions) — without it, the review step fails with a 401.
exportWizard.checklistIngestToken: Add the DEVDIGEST_INGEST_TOKEN secret above so CI Runs gets updated.
exportWizard.checklistMerge: Merge the workflow file before opening a test PR — GitHub only runs workflows already on the base branch.
